summary: This showcase demonstrates an end-game Corrosion team defeating Mekkatorque, the Season 8 endgame boss, achieving an S rank with over 1.41 billion total damage. The team is composed of Whisk, Sacredeia, Rook, Szecedith, and Reytah. Rook acts as the primary carry, contributing approximately 78% of the entire team's damage. Detailed hero gear builds, attributes, and specific skill timing rotations are highlighted to ensure optimal debuff application and uptime.

heroes.name: Rook
heroes.verdict: Top DPS carry for Corrosion teams against Mekkatorque
heroes.note: Dealt 1.099 billion damage (78% of the total team damage) utilizing default skill timings to capitalize on enemy Corrosion stacks.

heroes.name: Sacredeia
heroes.note: Contributed 114.8M damage while maintaining consistent Corrosion debuffs using an 11.6s first cast and 17.5s recast.

heroes.name: Whisk
heroes.verdict: Corrosion buffer and poison damage dealer
heroes.note: Provided steady Corrosion application and self-buffs, dealing 70.4M damage with an 11.3s first cast and 15s recast timing.

heroes.name: Szecedith
heroes.note: Inflicted Corruption and poison damage contributing 77.8M damage, timed at 12.5s first cast and 17.5s recast.

heroes.name: Reytah
heroes.note: Inflicted poison debuffs, slowed boss skill recharge, and dispelled ally debuffs with an 11.4s first cast and 15s recast.

teams.note: High-scoring Poison/Corrosion team achieving 1.41B total damage to earn an S rank in Phase 1 of Mekkatorque.

tips: Prioritize offensive stats, attack, and enlightenment heavily on Rook, as he provides the vast majority of the damage output in a Corrosion setup.

Fine-tune ultimate skill timers for support and debuff units (Whisk at 11.3s/15s, Sacredeia at 11.6s/17.5s, Szecedith at 12.5s/17.5s, Reytah at 11.4s/15s) while keeping Rook on default cast to consistently detonate Corrosion.
title: Corrosion vs Mekkatorque (Phase 1) | Endgame Boss | Season 8 | Dragonheir
